answer: By the vault of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. A jetty of per-task receipts records who did what, and the saffron of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
